v 3.5.1
Upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/mimalloc/releases/tag/v3.5.1
Commit: 34fbd7e7cd4627424490afe19b20f8066bfc537d

Applied local compatibility patches

Windows clang/MinGW new-handler compatibility:
- Status: applied to src/alloc.c.
- The weak std::get_new_handler fallback is limited to non-Windows targets.
- Windows uses the existing NULL fallback because COFF linkers do not reliably
  coalesce the weak fallback with the C++ runtime definition.
- WaterWall does not use mimalloc's mi_new APIs.
- Reapply this guard when updating the vendored mimalloc sources.

Idempotent automatic process initialization:
- Status: applied to src/init.c.
- Windows MinGW/Clang can invoke the loader hook from both TLS callbacks and a
  compiler constructor. Guard the whole hook with mimalloc's mi_atomic_do_once,
  not only mi_process_init, so output setup and other loader work run once.
- Duplicate output initialization otherwise flushes a stray newline to stderr
  before main, breaking ordinary/packed startup equivalence.
- Keep the existing packed-application output comparison exact; reapply this
  guard when updating mimalloc unless upstream provides equivalent protection.
